exceptions.title: commits a hover open while the hover event is dispatched
exceptions.reason: Vue has no `flushSync`, so the popup renders in the update after the hover event, and a listener of the same event does not find it. The case `shows the popup after the awaited hover event` asserts the popup after the awaited event.

exceptions.title: closes a cursor-tracking tooltip when an inactive trigger is pressed
exceptions.reason: The case needs `trackCursorAxis` of the root, which needs the cursor anchor. `Tooltip.Viewport` is the last part of the family, so the row names its file.
